content.json:
# EGP Window — Security dashboard
Auth outcomes, authz denials, PHI hygiene signals. Data from the `egp_maf.audit` structured-log logger + typed error codes.

content.query:
AppEvents
| where Name in ("authz.granted", "authz.denied", "auth.token_invalid", "auth.role_denied")
| summarize c=count() by Name, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| render timechart
content.title: Audit events over time

content.query:
AppEvents
| where Name == "authz.denied"
| summarize denials=count() by clinician_id=tostring(Properties.clinician_id), bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| top 20 by denials
content.title: Top 20 clinicians by authz.denied (rate anomaly candidates)

content.query:
AppEvents
| where Name == "auth.token_invalid"
| summarize c=count() by reason=tostring(Properties.reason), bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| render timechart
content.title: auth.token_invalid by reason
